title: Existence of normalized self-Tor comparison
statement: For every commutative ring A, ideal I and natural number n, there exists an A-linear morphism from the exterior conormal module [new-r4-conormal-exterior-module] to Tor_n^A(A/I,A/I) satisfying [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-predicate]. No regularity hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09PQ, strictly graded commutative Tor; Tag 00LS, comparison of free complexes with resolutions

proof.text: Obtain a comparison and its chosen-lift wedge formula from the Tate construction.
The homotopy normalization theorem upgrades the chosen-lift formula to every augmentation lift, giving the unchanged existence statement.

based_on.place: Tag 09PQ construction; Tag 00LS homotopy comparison, formalized separately

theorem selfTorConormalComparison_exists (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : conormalExteriorModule A I n ⟶
      ((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)), IsSelfTorConormalComparison A I n c
